name: UNAS-4
title: UNAS 4
summary: Compact 4-bay UniFi NAS + 2 NVMe cache, 2.5GbE, powered by included 90 W PoE+++ adapter.

requires: 90W PoE+++ (802.3bt) adapter (included) or bt switch port

extra.console_note: runs UniFi Drive; whether a separate console is required not stated in specs

gotchas: Single 2.5GbE port — caps throughput at ~280 MB/s; no 10G/SFP+ (bigger UNAS models have it).
Powered by PoE+++ (90 W, 802.3bt Type 4) — uses the included adapter unless your switch has 90 W ports (USW-Pro-XG-24-PoE).
Only one RAID group; RAID 5/6/10 only.
NVMe slots are cache, capped at 2 TiB each.
best_for: home/small-office backups in a UniFi stack
